content:
Maya (product): Quick design review request — small UX nits across Compliance panel: retention summary phrasing, region picker affordance, encryption badge hierarchy (managed vs BYOK), and audit-log CTA copy. Can we thread feedback here?
Sam (design): SGTM. I pulled some screen grabs into the figma link above. key concerns: retention summary feels dense, encrypt badge is visually same weight as region, and audit CTA reads like an action but it's actually a filtered download.
Oliver (eng): FYI some constraints: audit export currently streams and uses e.g. `export_logs?since=...&region=...` so changing CTA to a modal is possible but needs backend param changes.
Jess (a11y): Also flagging keyboard order on the Compliance row — when tabbing, KMS badge is after the region dropdown which breaks natural left-to-right flow. Need to reorder DOM for linear focus.
Maya (product): Good catch, @Jess. I'd prefer visual order == focus order. Sam, can we try swapping positions in the mock?
Sam (design): Yep. Two microcopy options for retention summary:
  A) "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more about retention policies."
  B) "Retention: 30 days — adjustable per workspace. View details."
Which reads clearer for users scanning a list?
Priya (legal): Option A is safer — "Learn more" -> links to the policy page. Avoid implying per-workspace guarantees unless we have the feature GA.
Oliver (eng): Also note: if we add "adjustable per workspace" we need to guard that link on the API surface. Might leak early info.
Maya (product): Ok lean A. Sam: compress copy to single line so it doesn't wrap in table rows.
Sam (design): For encryption badge hierarchy: suggestion is to visually de-emphasize the default-managed key badge and surface BYOK as a compact pill with a tooltip. Proposed tooltip copy: `Customer-managed key (BYOK). Keys are stored in your KMS. See key ownership docs.`
Jess (a11y): Tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and expose role="tooltip" with aria-describedby on the pill button. Also ensure tooltip content is plain text (no links) or if links exist they must be in the DOM and keyboard-focusable.
Oliver (eng): Implementation note: we can make the badge a `<button aria-describedby="kms-help-<id>">` and render tooltip in DOM with `id=kms-help-<id>` so screen readers can announce. Performance-wise trivial.
Sam (design): Audit-log CTA — current label says "Download audit log". Two alternatives: "Export logs" vs "Download filtered logs" vs "Export (CSV)". Thoughts?
Maya (product): We need clarity that it respects the current filters/time range. Prefer explicit: "Export filtered logs" or "Export (filtered)".
Priya (legal): Use the word "Export" not "Download"? Either ok but be consistent across product. Also avoid "audit log" in a way that sounds like legal evidence — fine here but documentation needs to match.
Jess (a11y): For screen reader users, label should include purpose: e.g., `Export filtered logs (CSV)` as accessible name. Avoid relying on icon-only buttons.
Oliver (eng): Backend side: we already accept `format=csv|json`. If we add explicit CTA `(CSV)` we can pre-set format param client-side. Low effort.
Sam (design): Another nit: region picker placeholder currently says "Region" — users confused if empty. Proposal: show current region or fallback label "All regions". Also add descriptive aria-label `Region selector — filters resources by region`.
Maya (product): Agree show "All regions" instead of empty. Jess, add ARIA suggestion for accessible name?
Jess (a11y): Use `aria-label="Region selector. Currently: All regions. Opens popup to filter by cloud region."` and ensure the popup has `role="listbox"` and each option `role="option"` + aria-selected. Keyboard nav: arrow keys cycle, enter selects, escape closes.
Oliver (eng): Noted. We already use Downshift-like behavior for listbox; will align roles. Edge case: mobile touch targets need 44px min.
Sam (design): Final microcopy proposals (single-line friendly):
  - Retention: "Data retained for 30 days. Learn more."
  - KMS badge tooltip: "Customer-managed key (BYOK). Keys stored in your KMS."
  - Encrypt badge alt: default badge copy -> "Redwood-managed key"
  - Audit CTA: "Export filtered logs (CSV)"
  - Region fallback: "All regions"
Maya (product): I like those. @Priya anything to tweak?
Priya (legal): Fine with those, just ensure the docs link target for "Learn more" goes to retention policy that includes legal retention exceptions. We'll coordinate offline.
Oliver (eng): I'll land a PR to: swap DOM order region -> badge, add aria attributes, and change CTA label to include `(CSV)`. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Jess (a11y): I'll add a quick checklist for QA:
  - Focus order matches visual order
  - Tooltip reachable via keyboard and read by SRs
  - Buttons have aria-labels with context
  - Export action announces file format before download
Sam (design): Updated mocks linked in figma (v3) with single-line copy and swapped ordering. Also reduced badge contrast and added subtle chevron to region.
Maya (product): Thanks all. Small follow-ups: @Oliver please ping thread with PR link, @Sam include screenshot of collapsed vs expanded row for sizing, @Jess I'll loop you into QA run. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Figma file updated: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/compliance-ui/v3 (view-only)
Oliver (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webapp/pull/4727 — includes aria labels, copy updates, and export param. Tests added.
Jess (a11y): Running quick local check now. Will report any SR quirks in this thread.
Maya (product): Great, thanks everyone — closing the loop after QA passes. :rocket:
